title: Packet privacy across every employer-facing surface

metrics.reason: A denominator, not a quality. Its job is to make `forbidden_fields_found = 0` readable — zero findings over zero surfaces is not a pass — and a page that failed to render is already reported as a finding, so the check that matters is gated there rather than here.

notes: Assembles a packet for every cohort connection through the real assemblePacket against a seeded database, then scans the three things that actually leave the program — the employer response page (rendered), the employer email, and the résumé content the PDF carries — against the same denylist packet-shared.test.ts and workforce-batch.test.ts pin, plus phone/email/ZIP patterns. Résumé tailoring is not mocked: the scorer seeds a ResumeVersion for each (student, lead) pair, which is the reuse branch assemblePacket already takes, so no AI call happens and no module has to be stubbed. Reports `skipped` without a database rather than failing.
